dedupe_keys.name: worldpop harmonised annual global geospatial covariates for population modelling

description: This WorldPop collection provides annual, spatially and temporally harmonised global geospatial covariates designed to drive gridded population distribution models, which also serve as consistent context layers for other environmental, economic and health applications. It covers the globe with 73 covariates on a common master grid, including inland water masks and distances to coastlines from ESA WorldCover, elevation and slope from MERIT DEM, annual surface temperature and precipitation for 2015 to 2023, night-time lights, distances to land cover class edges, and built-up, building and road layers. It was produced by D. Woods, T. McKeen, A. Cunningham, R. Priyatikanto, A. J. Tatem, A. Sorichetta and M. Bondarenko at WorldPop, University of Southampton, and described in Gates Open Research in September 2025. The covariates are available for download as GeoTIFF from the WorldPop hub, or in bulk per country from the WorldPop FTP server, under CC BY 4.0, except layers derived from OpenStreetMap or Microsoft building and road data, which are under ODbL; the harmonisation code is on GitHub. Caveats: the new master grid does not align with earlier WorldPop grids. It supports exposure mapping of population and infrastructure for hazard and resilience studies across sectors; a related record is the Copernicus GHSL built-up and population layers.
licence: CC-BY-4.0 (ODbL for layers derived from OpenStreetMap and Microsoft data)
